entries.54eafa25bf3f29f0: Centered on the global hotel brand 'Comfort', owned by the U.S. company Choice Hotels International, it operates limited-service hotels mainly located in front of stations in ordinance-designated cities and similar areas across Japan. As of June 30, 2026, there were 100 hotels with 14,517 rooms. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥47,164 million.
entries.6f8c35f29a0d2010: It is a dedicated hotel operator that generates revenue by operating hotels. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Hotel Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥53,998 million, and as of June 30, 2026, it operated 120 hotels with 16,942 rooms.
entries.7bee915e1b6ae736: Local companies, organizations and individuals using banquets and meetings
entries.d3da752c5d1008ce: GREENS is a specialist hotel operator that runs hotels nationwide, centered on "Comfort."
entries.d750dee2eb7439ba: Tenants such as restaurants and convenience stores in hotels
entries.de0fcd3f32929c64: Centered on Mie Prefecture, it operates hotels tailored to local needs, from limited-service hotels to hotels with restaurants and banquet halls. As of June 30, 2026, there were 20 hotels with 2,425 rooms. Revenue is disclosed together with other businesses; revenue from Original Brands and other businesses for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥6,833 million.
entries.ea9593d6abfeda21: To make effective use of hotel real estate, it runs a leasing business and a real estate management business for tenants and others in facilities attached to its hotels. Revenue is less than 1% of total revenue, so the amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.ee551eb9d3ba520f: Leisure travelers, mainly families and couples
